rules.no_pass_by_existence: PASS is only recorded where a named executable test proves the link; a command/capability merely existing never yields PASS downstream.
rules.gap_semantics: MISSING = the link does not exist and nothing blocks building it; BLOCKED = closing it requires an ownership/architecture decision owned elsewhere; NOT_APPLICABLE = the link is meaningless for this operation (e.g. external side effects with no deterministic artifact).
